about: Known-answer rules questions for evals/run.py. Every expected verdict comes from a ruling or rule printed by lookup.py when the question was written (card database built 2026-10-05, CR effective 2026-09-25), never from memory. Rulings are quoted by text, not by id: ruling ids are positional and shift when Scryfall adds one.

questions.question: Blood Moon and Urborg are both on the battlefield. Can I tap my Forest for black mana?

expect.verdict: No. Blood Moon turns Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth into a Mountain that loses its ability, so it no longer makes lands Swamps, whichever of the two entered first. The Forest taps only for green.

source.ruling: it won't turn lands into Swamps, no matter in what order those effects started to apply

questions.question: Opalescence was on the battlefield first, then Humility entered. What are Humility's power and toughness now?

expect.verdict: Humility is a 1/1 creature (still an enchantment) with no abilities. Opalescence makes it 4/4 in layer 7b, then Humility's later timestamp makes it 1/1.

source.ruling: Humility becomes 4/4 and Worship becomes 4/4. (Opalescence). Humility becomes 1/1 and Worship becomes 1/1 (Humility)

questions.question: Humility and Opalescence are both in play. How big is Humility?

expect.verdict: It depends on which entered last, which the question doesn't say: Humility is 1/1 if Humility entered after Opalescence, and 4/4 if Humility entered before Opalescence. A correct reply asks for the order or gives both branches.

source.ruling: But if Humility entered before Opalescence

questions.question: I control Doubling Season and cast Jace, the Mind Sculptor. How much loyalty does he enter with, and where is he after I use his +2 right away?

expect.verdict: He enters with 6 loyalty (double his printed 3). The +2 is a cost, not an effect, so it isn't doubled: he goes to 8.

source.ruling: those counters are put on as a cost, not as an effect

questions.question: I control Hardened Scales and Doubling Season. An effect puts one +1/+1 counter on my creature. How many counters does it get?

expect.verdict: The creature's controller chooses the order of the two replacement effects: 4 counters if Hardened Scales applies first (1+1, then doubled), 3 if Doubling Season applies first (doubled, then +1). So up to 4.

source.ruling: you choose the order to apply those effects

questions.question: My indestructible creature gets -5/-5 and its toughness drops to 0. Does it die?

expect.verdict: Yes. A creature with toughness 0 or less is put into its owner's graveyard as a state-based action. That isn't destruction, so indestructible doesn't stop it.

questions.question: I Clone a creature that has three +1/+1 counters and an Aura on it. Does my Clone get the counters or the Aura's bonus?

expect.verdict: No. Clone copies only what is printed on the creature (its copiable values), not counters, attached Auras or other effects changing its power and toughness.

source.ruling: It doesn't copy whether that creature is tapped or untapped, whether it has any counters on it or Auras and Equipment attached to it

questions.question: My creature is enchanted with my opponent's Pacifism. I Cloudshift it. What happens to Pacifism?

expect.verdict: Pacifism is put into its owner's graveyard. The creature returns as a new object with no relation to the old one, so the Aura is no longer attached to anything.

source.ruling: Auras attached to the exiled permanent will be put into their owners' graveyards

questions.question: What is the mana value of Insectile Aberration on the battlefield?

expect.verdict: 1. The back face of a transforming double-faced card uses the mana cost of its front face, Delver of Secrets ({U}).

questions.question: What is the mana value of Fire // Ice in my hand, and what is it on the stack if I cast Ice?

expect.verdict: 4 in hand (both halves combined, {1}{R} + {1}{U}); 2 on the stack when cast as Ice (only that half).

source.ruling: A split card's characteristics are a combination of its two halves while it is not on the stack

questions.question: My opponent counters my Stomp. Can I still cast Bonecrusher Giant from exile later?

expect.verdict: No. A countered Adventure spell isn't exiled; the card goes to the graveyard, so there is nothing to cast later.

source.ruling: that card won't be exiled and the spell's controller won't be able to cast it as a permanent later

questions.question: Ragavan connects and exiles a land from the top of my opponent's library. Can I play that land this turn?

expect.verdict: No. Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer lets you cast the exiled card, and a land can't be cast; you can't play it.

source.ruling: If you exile a land card, you can't play that card

questions.question: My opponent has Stony Silence. Can I still sacrifice my Treasure tokens for mana?

expect.verdict: No. Treasure's ability is an activated ability of an artifact, and Stony Silence stops all of those, mana abilities included.

source.ruling: No abilities of artifacts can be activated, including mana abilities

questions.question: The Ring tempts me for the second time and I choose a different creature. Do I now have two Ring-bearers?

expect.verdict: No. Each player can have only one Ring-bearer at a time; the newly chosen creature becomes the Ring-bearer and the first one stops being it.
cards: The Ring // The Ring Tempts You

source.ruling: only one Ring-bearer at a time

questions.question: Lune de sang est en jeu chez mon adversaire. Je joue Épopée d'Urza. Est-ce que je dois la sacrifier ?

expect.verdict: Non. Lune de sang en fait une Montagne qui perd ses capacités de chapitre, et seule une Saga qui a au moins une capacité de chapitre est sacrifiée (règle 714.4). Elle reste en jeu et produit du rouge. (No: it stays on the battlefield as a Mountain.)

questions.question: Bob reveals Fire // Ice on my upkeep. How much life do I lose?

expect.verdict: 4. The card is not on the stack, so its mana value is that of both halves combined.

source.ruling: A split card's characteristics are a combination of its two halves while it is not on the stack

questions.question: My opponent has Teferi on the battlefield. Can I cast my instant during their turn?

expect.verdict: It depends on which Teferi, which the question doesn't say. Under Teferi, Time Raveler or Teferi, Mage of Zhalfir, no: opponents can cast spells only at sorcery timing. Most other Teferi cards don't restrict it. A correct reply asks which Teferi or says explicitly which one it assumed.

source.ruling: it must be that opponent's turn, during a main phase, and the stack must be empty

questions.question: My opponent controls Elesh Norn. I cast Mulldrifter for its full cost. Do I draw two cards?

expect.verdict: It depends on which Elesh Norn. With Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines, no: permanents entering don't cause abilities of permanents her opponents control to trigger. With Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite, yes: the enters trigger still happens even though Mulldrifter then dies as a 0/0. A correct reply asks which one or gives the branches.

source.ruling: affects a permanent's own enters-the-battlefield triggered abilities

questions.question: How does Zorvax, the Unprinted work with Doubling Season? Does its token get doubled?

expect.verdict: No card named Zorvax, the Unprinted exists. A correct reply says it could not find the card and asks for its Oracle text (or the right name). It must not invent what the card does.

questions.question: Is Mana Crypt legal in Commander?

expect.verdict: The bundled data holds no format legality. A correct reply either gives the legality with a web source it retrieved in this session, or says plainly that it could not retrieve it. A bare answer from memory, presented as certain, is a fail whatever it says.

questions.question: I control Panharmonicon and evoke Mulldrifter. How many cards do I draw?

expect.verdict: Four. Mulldrifter's enters ability triggers twice. (The evoke sacrifice also triggers twice; the second does nothing.)

source.ruling: it just causes the ability to trigger twice

questions.question: quick: Ruby Medallion is out and I cast Fireball with X=3 at a single target. What do I pay?

expect.verdict: {2}{R}, three mana in total: {X}{R} with X=3 is {3}{R}, and Ruby Medallion takes {1} off the generic part once.

source.ruling: you choose the value of X before calculating the spell's total cost

questions.question: My 5/5 with deathtouch and trample is blocked by a 4/4. How much damage can I assign to the player? quick

expect.verdict: 4. One damage from a deathtouch source is lethal damage, so 1 goes to the blocker and the other 4 can trample over.

questions.question: My opponent casts Krosan Grip on my Sensei's Divining Top. Can I respond by tapping the Top to draw a card?

expect.verdict: No. While a spell with split second is on the stack, players can't activate abilities that aren't mana abilities, and the Top's draw ability isn't one.

source.ruling: their options are just limited to mana abilities and certain special actions

questions.question: My commander gets hit by Path to Exile. Can I put it in the command zone, and what will it cost me to cast it again?

expect.verdict: Yes: once it is in exile its owner may put it into the command zone (a state-based action). Casting it from the command zone costs {2} more for each previous time it was cast from there.

questions.question: Rest in Peace is out. My creature is destroyed. Does my Blood Artist trigger?

expect.verdict: No. The creature is exiled instead of being put into the graveyard, so it never dies and abilities that trigger on a creature dying don't trigger.

source.ruling: abilities that trigger whenever a creature dies won't trigger

questions.question: Est-ce que le contact mortel fonctionne quand ma créature se bat (fight) contre une autre ? vite

expect.verdict: Oui. Le contact mortel s'applique à tout dégât infligé par la source, pas seulement aux dégâts de combat : la créature qui reçoit les dégâts est détruite. (Yes, deathtouch works with fight.)
